tests.name: A queued purchase expiring before dispatch is durably rejected without a retry
A queued purchase cannot outlive its confirmed quote across suspend and resume
Session maintenance cannot authorize an expired purchase with its new credentials
An unexpired confirmation transmits once and reconciles without replay
A failed rejection write retains non-transmission evidence until storage recovers
Dispatch uses the durable quote and refuses unavailable or uncommitted journal state
An unreadable journal still returns a held non-transmitted result to the caller
Refusing a stale dispatch preserves the earlier outcome_unknown range outcome
Refusing a stale dispatch preserves the earlier access_confirmed range outcome
Refusing a duplicate dispatch saves a held unknown outcome without negating it
The synchronous service also checks expiry after its intent is committed

limits: Controlled asynchronous workers with production Controller, SessionRunner and SQLite
No real account, network request or payment
